title: Scam
body: I was using FlightView (free app). A pop up for Track My Flight Now appeared at the bottom. I tried to ignore/get rid of the popup and suddenly the app opened. I did not agree to pay, but it charged me anyway. I want the charge removed.

title: Liars and Cheets!
body: Bought FlightView Elite for the lifetime access and they cheated the system by removing the app from the store and releasing this sub par app for a stupid insane subscription price. 10,000years bad juju on them! I will never give to this company again!

title: Unreliable
body: The app constantly crashes. Was unable to track son’s flight to Malaysia. This app trash. I will definitely seek a refund

title: Unexpected charges.
body: I was looking at 4 flight trackers in November before my family’s flight. I chose another flight tracker. Never gave My Flight Now another thought until today when my credit card company contacted me. I went to the Apple site to look at all of my payments for subscriptions. I was shocked to see I have paid $9.99+ tax for the last four weeks to track flights. We may have 2 flights a year and definitely don’t need a subscription like this. My error or their error for not being more explicit. Just be careful if you look at this one. 🥴😥

title: Bait and switch
body: I was happily using my trusted Flight View app when I was suddenly redirected to this other flight app. Thinking it was an update to FlightView, I clicked a button and was automatically signed up for a subscription. I've been trying g to cancel it for 20 min and in the Terms of Service it says how simple it is to cancel through Apple, and yet the link provided goes nowhere. I had to send 2 emails and just hope they receive my request and cancel this subscription. Incredibly frustrating!

title: Tricks you into buying
body: It try’s to trick you into buying so pay attention when you download and go on app. Doesn’t let you see unless you pay.

title: Horrible application
body: Too many adds. Impossible to use. Avoid this one.

title: does work and paid
body: It makes you pay to use it and then when you do pay it doesn’t even work. I restarted the app, deleted it and redownloaded it and it still won’t work. it just keeps saying error DO NOT GET THIS.

title: Bait and switch
body: My old FlightView App was very easy to navigate. Now I am forced to get this new App and pay to use it. Seems like a scam to me. I will Not pay 5 bucks a month for this switch….

title: Not accurate
body: This app is not accurate. It does not display many flights . Don’t buy!

title: Opened once and keep being charged
body: Horrible!!!! Been charged 5.99 a week since I finally caught it. Downloaded and used once and this stupid app has been charging me weekly. Shame!!!! Will be contacting Amex to reverse all charges. Thieves.

title: Beware!!!!!! Do not purchase
body: Do not purchase this!! This app will be billed to your account weekly before you realize it. There are many other reasonable alternatives.

title: So annoying!!
body: I opened it and it immediately wanted me to pay for a subscription. Once I got past that and had the free three days, I looked up a flight and it didn’t show me anything. all it said was was flight not available. I looked it up multiple times wording it different every single time and it still didn’t work. This is definitely the app for you if you want to pay six dollars a month to look at a flight. All I wanted was to watch my friends flight and make sure she made it there safely and also it’s cool to watch the plane go. And this app was very slow and kind of glitchy. It didn’t have a place to cancel the subscription, that I had no choice to make. I immediately deleted the app after all my troubles and I suggest if you have the same problem, then you too. Also, just as a reminder, there are plenty of apps that do the exact same thing for free. if you’re like me and don’t wanna pay money to use an app then you’ll understand my review.

title: Scam
body: I downloaded this app looked up one flight, then closed it, and deleted the app. In the mean time, they auto enrolled me in their 5.99/week subscription. I never double clicked any confirmation to subscribe to anything. Be aware there are other apps that do this for free.

title: Scam
body: Says free with in app purchases but everything requires a subscription - do not waste time downloading this app

title: Too expensive
body: This app uses free tracking information from the FAA and repackages it then charges $5.95 per week. It’s almost like they’re stealing your money. RIP OFF!

title: Scam
body: Tries to trick you into thinking it’s a free app then blocks you with a paywall. Waste of time and unethical marketing strategy.

title: Unauthorized charges
body: I was charged twice in one week 5.99 for this app only for viewing my husband’s flight once. No idea I was being charged at all and never would have paid for a subscription to view a flight. Beware/ this is a scam. Seeing as how many others are having this same issue. Disputing with Apple and my bank.

title: Scam App
body: Scam app gets you to download it saying it’s free. Then it forces you into a $5.99 per week paid subscription before you can even use it. It’s a total scam. The only free part is the actual download; nothing else (it’s a useless waste of time)

title: SCAM! Weekly Charges!!!!
body: I downloaded app, hated performance, so I deleted it. The developer charged me a weekly subscription fee of $5.99 plus tax. I just now noticed the third charge, but Apple wouldn’t reimburse me. Now I will dispute this fraud with Chase who is good about supporting me. THIS ISN’T FREE!!! Probably a devious China developer.

title: Worst App
body: They are just spending money on advertisement of this app not functionality. This is the worst app I have ever downloaded.

title: Hate it !!!!
body: “Track My Flight Now“ is obnoxious and it made me instantly hate this app. It looks good and so I installed it to track a delayed Air Canada flight today. As soon as it was installed it started to prompt me to accept a quite expensive upgrade again & again. I might have upgraded at some time later after having had a chance to see what this app can do better than my other 2 apps which I have successfully used for years. But after having been prompted over 5 times to accept the upgrade at $4 per month without ever having seen how this app performs I gave up and happily deleted it. Hasta La Vista; I won’t be Back !!!

title: Monthly Subscription !
body: They don’t make it plain thats this is a subscription that bills you weekly!!! found that to be totally misleading and a rip off for what they charge. When I loaded it on my phone, no indication of reoccurring subscription costs. Plenty of free options that do the same.

title: Useless unless you add paid version
body: As soon as you hit the search engine, it says we found your flight, but you have to sign up for a free trial and paid version to even look at it. Absolutely worthless.

title: Insane subscription
body: These guys want $5.99 a week. Over $311 a year!!! They don’t have the guts to tell you that is a weekly subscription. Yes I know you did post it but you’re trying to trick the customers. Shame on you…… of course it’s a free country

title: Says it’s free, until you download it
body: I support that that developers should be paid for their work, but when an app is advertised as “free” but that’s not true, I’m irritated. Just be upfront about the cost.
